content.short: XOCIETY is a high-fidelity AAA "POP" shooter on Sui featuring an immersive player-driven virtual economy for all.
content.description: XOCIETY is a premier AAA-quality decentralized third-person shooter developed by industry veterans, designed to bring professional-grade gaming to the high-performance Sui blockchain. The game features "POP" (Procedural Outbreak PvP) mechanics, blending intense action combat with deep RPG elements and a rich narrative campaign. XOCIETY stands out for its immersive virtual economy, where every in-game action—from resource gathering to competitive combat—directly influences the broader player-driven market. As a flagship title for SuiPlay0X1, it focuses on player sovereignty.
content.meta: XOCIETY offers AAA extraction shooter gameplay and a player-driven virtual economy. Discover XOCIETY and other Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
